description: This file provides utility functions for encryption and decryption, including base64 encoding/decoding and Blowfish encryption/decryption, within the SuiteCRM project. It also manages system key retrieval, possibly generating a new key if not found.

classes.name: Crypt_Blowfish
classes.description: A class used for Blowfish encryption/decryption, instantiated in blowfishEncode and blowfishDecode functions.

methods.name: sugarEncode
methods.description: Performs base64 encoding on the input data (currently ignores the key parameter).

methods.name: sugarDecode
methods.description: Performs base64 decoding on the input data (currently ignores the key parameter).

methods.name: blowfishGetKey
methods.description: Retrieves the system's private Blowfish key, generating and caching a new one if necessary.

methods.name: blowfishEncode
methods.description: Encrypts data using Blowfish cipher, base64 encodes the encrypted data, and includes the IV.

methods.name: blowfishDecode
methods.description: Decodes base64-encoded Blowfish encrypted data and decrypts it.
